name: plantuml-diagrams
title: PlantUML
description: Draw PlantUML diagrams in issues, comments and Knowledge Base articles. Insert a PlantUML block from the editor toolbar and type the diagram source. The diagram is rendered in your browser: the source is not sent to a server. C4 diagrams are supported. When you attach the app to a project, the app edits the issues and articles of that project: it replaces ```plantuml code blocks with diagrams, also in old items, on behalf of the user who opens the item. Detach the app to stop these changes.
